is recognized as a top lift company in Bangalore. Their commitment to quality, safety, and design innovation has made them a preferred choice among architects and homeowners alike.

In this guide, we’ll explore the top lift designs for homes in Bangalore, focusing on style, function, and practicality. Whether you’re building a new house or upgrading an existing one, choosing the right design with expert elevator services in Bangalore can elevate both your lifestyle and property value.
Glass Capsule Lifts – For Style & Transparency

Glass capsule lifts are the epitome of modern elegance and architectural brilliance. These lifts add a sophisticated, futuristic look to homes and are perfect for central atriums or villas with open design layouts.

Glass capsule lifts offered by the top lift company in Bangalore are engineered for silent operation and can be customized to fit compact or circular shafts. With expert elevator services in Bangalore, these designs offer a perfect balance of aesthetics and accessibility.
1. Top Lift Company in Bangalore – Hydraulic Lifts for Independent Homes
Hydraulic lifts are well-suited for low-rise homes with 2–4 floors. These lifts don’t require a machine room, making them ideal for space-conscious homes in Bangalore.

Builders and homeowners often prefer hydraulic lifts because they’re reliable, safe, and easier to install. When serviced regularly through trusted elevator services in Bangalore, their lifespan and performance are exceptional.
2. Machine-Room-Less (MRL) Lifts – For Modern Urban Homes

MRL lifts are designed for homeowners who want a fully functional lift with a minimal structural footprint. These lifts eliminate the need for a separate machine room, making them perfect for duplexes or premium apartments.
The top lift company in Bangalore offers MRL lifts with advanced safety features, regenerative drives, and elegant cabin finishes that seamlessly integrate with the home's interior.
3. Pitless Lifts – Perfect for Retrofit Projects

Renovating your home and need a lift but don’t want major civil changes? Pitless lifts are the solution. These lifts do not require a deep pit or overhead room, making them ideal for homes with foundation limitations.
Easy to install in existing homes
Suitable for homes with limited space
Pitless lifts, when installed and maintained by a professional elevator services in Bangalore provider, ensure long-term safety and minimal disruption to the existing structure.
4. Custom Luxury Lifts – Tailored to Your Vision
If your home design is truly one-of-a-kind, your lift should be too. Custom luxury lifts can be designed from scratch to match your interior aesthetics, color schemes, and space preferences.
Premium wood, mirror, or glass finishes
Custom lighting, flooring, and ceiling designs
Advanced safety panels and smart access

Working with the top lift company in Bangalore, these luxury lifts can be built around your lifestyle. Whether you want a classic European look or a sleek minimalist design, BG Elevators offers tailor-made solutions.
These cutting-edge lifts are powered by air pressure and require no cables, counterweights, or oils. They're compact, eco-friendly, and visually stunning.
Though not as common, when handled by skilled elevator services in Bangalore, these lifts offer a futuristic experience with minimal maintenance and strong reliability.
6. Dumbwaiters – For Utility Transport Inside the Home
Dumbwaiters are smaller lifts used for transporting items such as groceries, laundry, or dishes between floors. Though not people-carrying, they add immense utility to multi-level homes.
Can be added to kitchens or utility areas
This small but effective solution is also part of the smart vertical transport ecosystem offered by the top lift company in Bangalore.

While design is important, other practical aspects must guide your final decision.
Shaft size, ceiling height, and pit depth

This is where an expert partner like BG Elevators plays a crucial role. Their team will evaluate your architectural layout, lifestyle requirements, and safety needs to recommend the ideal lift solution.

9. Maintenance: The Backbone of Long-Term Safety
Regardless of design, every home lift requires regular service and inspection. Preventive maintenance is the key to ensuring ride comfort, safety, and longevity.
